title: The Halfway Lantern
skyStory: Exactly half lit and still lounging in Capricorn, the moon is a lantern on a mountain ledge. Capricorn likes things done properly, so tonight the stars are lined up in neat rows like jars in a pantry. Saturn has labelled each jar. Mars has opened one to sniff it and been asked to leave. Even the wind is minding its manners.

reading: The lantern on the ledge is lit for you too, Spark. Capricorn moons bring structure, and your scattered week is about to get shelves. Spend twenty minutes putting things where they belong, desk or mind. Your future self will send a thank-you note.

Somewhere around 11:05 am a coworker or neighbour will say something kind about how you explain things. Do not deflect. Do not say anyone could have done it. Say thank you, full stop, and let the compliment sit in your pocket like a warm stone. Life Path 3 is allowed to hear its own song.
joel.mission: Accept one compliment today with only the words thank you. No but, no actually, no shrug. Just the two words.
joel.omen: A jar with a handwritten label. It means order is coming to a mess you have been avoiding; start with the top shelf.

reading: Day two of the moon in your house, and you are glowing in a way people will notice without being able to explain. The Wood Rat in you knows exactly why: you have been seen. Someone will ask your opinion on something important today. Give the real one.

Late afternoon the light on the water will go copper and then lavender, like your ruby is painting the sky. Stand still for one full minute and watch it. Patience is your superpower, but today it is also a front-row seat. Saturn would like to remind you that the show is free.
nancy.mission: Watch the sky change colour for one full uninterrupted minute at sunset, then describe it to Joel in exactly ten words.
nancy.omen: A sailboat being pulled out of the water for winter. It means a long project is finally safe ashore; rest is earned.

together.text: Swap one photo each of the coziest corner in your home right now. No tidying first. The more honest the corner, the more points. Saturn judges coziness on a scale of one to sweater.
